raw: {"diagnosis": "LBBB", "stemi": "no", "rationale": "The QRS is wide (about 140 ms or more), with deep QS/rS complexes in V1–V3, broad notched monophasic R waves in I, aVL and V6, and no septal Q waves; the ST elevation in V1–V3 runs opposite to the QRS and stays small compared with the deep S waves, so it fits LBBB rather than meeting STEMI (Sgarbossa) criteria."}
